name: spider-curl.html
instructions:
1. To set up for the spider curl you need to either turn the arm padding around 180 degrees or position yourself at the front of the bench facing the seat.
2. Grab a barbell and hold it with an underhand grip around shoulder width apart.
3. Position yourself with your stomach on the padding and arms hanging off the high side.
4. Keep your eyes facing forward and slowly curl the weight up as far as possible.
5. Squeeze the biceps, pause, and then slowly lower the weight back to the bottom.
6. Repeat for desired reps.
